title: ReDoS fuzz payloads
description: Static catalog of attacker-shaped strings plus the regex shapes they stress. Designed to feed the Swift-side CI harness that measures per-pattern timeout behavior. Strings only; no regex is compiled or executed during artifact generation.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

payloads.description: Ordered list of payloads. Order is stable across rebuilds at a given seed.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across the artifact.

pattern_class.description: Which family of catastrophic-backtracking shape the payload stresses.

attacker_input.description: The fuzz string. Length bounds are enforced to keep CI runtime predictable.

target_regex_shape.description: Human-readable description of the regex family this payload is designed to break, for example '(a+)+b'. Not itself a compilable regex.

expected_behavior.description: Expected runtime class when the payload is fed to the target regex. Superlinear payloads are the ones CI watches for timeout.
